sentences.text: Scientists estimated the total length of this giant dinosaur to be approximately 27.2 meters.
Thanom Luangnan found the fossil remains in Chaiyaphum province, Thailand, in 2016 within the Khok Kruat Formation.
This animal belongs to the family Euhelopodidae, a group of large sauropods.
One analysis suggested it was closely related to the European genus Europatitan at the base of this family.
Another study using different methods placed it in a more advanced position, appearing after Tangvayosaurus but before Phuwiangosaurus.
Nagatitan lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago.
